query: Consider the Non-Disclosure Agreement between University of Wisconsin Oshkosh; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold:
The Receiving Party’s designated representative may maintain one copy of all Confidential Information for the purpose of addressing any claim that may be brought under this Agreement and to comply with any other legal or recordkeeping requirements, and neither party will be obligated to destroy any Confidential Information that is stored electronically on back-up systems or computer hard drives after a file is deleted, but any such electronic information will continue to be subject to the terms of confidentiality under this Agreement.
The obligations and restrictions of confidentiality of the Receiving Party under this Agreement shall continue for a period of three (3) years from the date of termination of this Agreement.
rag_answer:
Yes. The document states that certain confidentiality obligations survive termination.

Specifically, Section 11 says the Agreement’s term expires after one year or earlier termination, but:

> “The obligations and restrictions of confidentiality of the Receiving Party under this Agreement shall continue for a period of three (3) years from the date of termination of this Agreement.”

Also, Section 4 provides that even after termination, if Confidential Information remains stored electronically on back-up systems or hard drives, “such electronic information will continue to be subject to the terms of confidentiality under this Agreement.”

judge.gold_summary: 协议终止后，接收方的保密义务仍存续三年；且即使电子备份或硬盘中的机密信息未被删除，这些信息仍继续受保密条款约束。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出文档确实提到保密义务在终止后继续存续，并引用了终止后三年继续有效的条款，同时说明电子备份或硬盘中的机密信息仍继续受保密条款约束。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键要点：保密义务在协议终止后继续存在三年，以及电子存储信息在终止后仍受保密条款约束；虽然未逐字提及指定代表可保留一份副本用于法律或记录要求，但这不影响对核心问题的命中。
